scripts.postinstall: prisma generate --schema=../backend/prisma/schema.prisma && node -e "const {cpSync}=require('fs');cpSync('../backend/node_modules/@prisma/client','./node_modules/@prisma/client',{recursive:true,force:true});cpSync('../backend/node_modules/.prisma','./node_modules/.prisma',{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('Prisma client synced to electron/node_modules')"
scripts.dmg:mac: hdiutil create -volname 'One' -srcfolder 'dist/mac-arm64/One.app' -ov -format UDZO 'dist/One-arm64-signed.dmg' && echo 'DMG rebuilt with signed app'
scripts.build:mac: cd ../backend && npx prisma generate && cd ../electron && npm run sync:prisma && npm run build:frontend && node -e "require('esbuild').buildSync({entryPoints:['../backend/src/server.js'],bundle:true,platform:'node',target:'node20',format:'cjs',outfile:'./backend-bundle/server.bundle.cjs',external:['@prisma/client','.prisma/client','bcrypt'],minify:false})" && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac && npm run sign:mac && npm run dmg:mac
scripts.build:win: cd ../backend && npx prisma generate && cd ../electron && npm run sync:prisma && npm run build:frontend && node -e "require('esbuild').buildSync({entryPoints:['../backend/src/server.js'],bundle:true,platform:'node',target:'node20',format:'cjs',outfile:'./backend-bundle/server.bundle.cjs',external:['@prisma/client','.prisma/client','bcrypt'],minify:false})" && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win
scripts.build:win:installer: npm run sync:prisma && npm run build:frontend && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --config.win.target=nsis
